item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-08-13
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 过去 24 小时，Nervos Talk 最大的动静来自 Spark Program 的一轮集中审批：委员会批准了 zk-Lock for CKB 和 CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint，同时拒绝了 QUIC Transport Validation、ckb-lint，并终止了 Cell Sandbox [S05, S07, S14, S16, S18]。Fiber RGB++ Swap 的讨论继续聚焦在节点架构上，Carl 和 Hanssen 正在来回确认哪些节点需要运行扩展版本 [S01, S02, S03]。另外，CrowdCell 提出 15,000 美元的主网上线赠款申请 [S04]，CKBA 治理问答也在继续 [S08, S10]。技术侧还有 CellScript 0.23.0 发布，主打兼容性和分发优化 [S13]。 ## 重点话题 **Spark 批准了两个新项目** [S05, S07]。 zk-Lock for CKB 被委员会认为有潜力交付可复用的 Groth16 锁脚本与开发者工具链 [S05]，项目方 Cecilia Mulandi 已经回帖提供收款地址和联系方式 [S06]。CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint 则拿到 1,204,820 CKB 的资助（按 0.00083 美元/CKB 换算），目标是给 CKB-VM 做 RISC-V 语义差分和 Lean 4 形式化验证 [S07]。 **Spark 也拒绝了一批申请** [S14, S16, S18]。 QUIC...

item.title: Spark Program | Fiber RGB++ Swap (3 posts)
item.description: No, not everyone needs a modified node. Only nodes that want to broadcast or relay swap advertisements need the extended build a regular user just connects their client to one of those directly. One real tradeoff: until more operators run the extended build, advertisements only reach nodes directly peered with an upgraded one, not the whole gossip network yet. Same bootstrapping situation CCH itself is in today Carl: No, not everyone needs a modified node. item.title: [DIS] CrowdCell: Mainnet Launch of Trustless All-or-Nothing Crowdfunding on CKB (1 posts)
item.description: Developed under the working name “Decentralized Kickstarter” through testnet. This proposal includes the rebrand to CrowdCell as part of mainnet readiness. 2. Summary This proposal requests a grant of $15,000 USD (payable in CKB equivalent at disbursement) to take CrowdCell from a verified testnet platform to a fully-deployed mainnet product. The scope covers: User dashboards: creator (“My campaigns”) and backer (“My pledges”) dashboards as the product surface a credible mainnet launch needs. Sustainable fee and treasury model: a 5% creator-side success-only fee, enforced on-chain via the pledge-lock script and routed to a multisig treasury. item.title: Spark Program | zk-Lock for CKB (2 posts)
item.description: Hi @Mulandi_Cecilia The committee has reviewed your revised proposal and decided to approve zk-Lock for CKB. We recognize the project’s potential to deliver a reusable Groth16 lock script and developer toolchain, creating a standardized integration layer for zero-knowledge applications on CKB. Based on the agreed $900 budget and the current CKB price of $0.00083, the grant amount is 1,084,338 CKB. Please reply to this thread with your CKB payout address, email address, and Discord handle to facilitate grant distribution and team communications. item.description: Hi @TinyuengKwan 委员会经过讨论，决定批准 CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint 项目立项。委员会认可本项目构建 CKB-VM 与 Sail RISC-V 语义差分工具 及 Lean 4 形式化证明 的潜力，这将提升 CKB 虚拟机核心语义的安全性与稳健性。 按照当前 CKB 价格 0.00083 美元换算，本期资助金额为 1,204,820 CKB。请在此回复提供你的 CKB 接收地址、联系邮箱 以及 Discord 账号，以便安排后续拨款与日常沟通。同时，我们会通过Discord 邀请你参加后续的 Ecosystem Monthly Call，与其他社区生态项目的开发者交流。 Hongzhou On Behalf of Spark Committee cc @Hanssen @yixiu.ckbfans.bit @xingtianchunyan

item.title: CellScript - A DSL for Cell-Based Contracts (1 posts)
item.description: CellScript 0.23.0 Release Notes Release: v0.23.0, In a Nutshell: CellScript 0.23.0 is primarily a compatibility and distribution release. The language surface is mostly unchanged. item.description: Hi Zynor, thanks for your ongoing building within the community. However, after careful review and consideration, the committee has decided to discontinue the project. The reasons are as follows: The committee feels that the improvements did not meet expectations and did not sufficiently benefit target users. There are factual errors within the educational project. The potential impact of this is significant and could lead developers to provide incorrect guidance. Therefore, we regretfully have to terminate the project. item.title: CKB Governance: cell-native DAO voting protocol on testnet (create poll question, vote, delegate, aggregate & close ) (1 posts)
item.description: Thanks @phroi, this was honestly helpful; I carefully traced the findings and they apply: subset finalization makes omission targetable by lane, and pending_intent_count currently provides no effective close invariant. The distinction between one-shot authority and the source of that authority also clarifies the remaining uniqueness problem. I will look into the iCKB path separately. I understand your time constraint and would respect that. I will review Deposit-Paired Voting publicly when I can give it proper attention. Thank you again for taking the time to examine the work.
